messages:
maria: Passing evening oncall to @aj. Planned deploy window tonight 23:30–00:10 UTC for services slate (edge + model-router). Quick highlights below:

maria: - Canary start at 23:30 UTC (10% traffic), ramp to 50% over 15m if no errors.
- DB migration at 23:40 UTC (fast schema tweak, will be read-only for ~60s).
- Freeze window: 23:25–00:10 UTC (no other deploys). Please don't promote unrelated branches.

aj: Thanks — taking over. Who's on rollback/watch?

maria: @kenji will watch runtime metrics, @sam owns DB migration and runbook. I'm on standby until 23:45 then offline. Contact list in the runbook: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/canary_slate

kenji: I'll monitor 95p/99p latency, error-rate, and queue depth. Dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/canary_slate
Will escalate if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 2m.

sam: DB migration note — it's a light column add with backfill toggled off. Plan is:
```
# migration steps
db-migrate apply --name add_user_flag --target canary
# set app to read-only on replicas for 60s
```
If replicas lag > 5s we pause and abort.

aj: Got it. Rollback command if we see issues:
```
deployctl rollback --service model-router --to previous
```
Also I'll mute alerts for noisy low-level warnings for 10m if we get a spike.

deploy-bot: Canary initiated at 23:30:00 UTC — model-router v2.8 -> 10% traffic. CI checks passed. :rocket:

ci-bot: Smoke tests started against canary at 23:31 UTC — basic inference + auth flow.

maria: One more FYI — traffic shaping will run on edge; expect slightly elevated 95p during ramp. This is expected; watch error rate, not latency alone. :eyes:

aj: Acknowledged. I'll add kenji and sam as watchers and post live updates here during the window. ping me @aj if anything urgent.

kenji: :thumbsup: I'll keep a 30s cadence on metrics.

sam: I'll be on-call at 23:35 for the migration. If we need to abort, we'll flip feature flag and revert migration via rollback plan.

aj: Handoff complete. Assigning watchers: kenji (runtime), sam (db), aj (oncall lead). I'll post final status once ramp completes.

maria: Thanks — leaving notes in the thread. Good luck!
